title: Web Application Security (OWASP Top 10)
description: Runnable companion for the OWASP Top 10 guide: security headers server, SSRF-safe fetch with IP allowlist, and a dependency audit script.
description_es: Companion ejecutable para la guía OWASP Top 10: servidor con security headers, fetch seguro contra SSRF con allowlist de IPs y script de auditoría de dependencias.
